title: TCL shows RayNeo X2 at CES 2023 (binocular full-colour microLED, Snapdragon XR2)

detail: X2 China pre-orders: 16MP camera (1080p/30), dual microLED 640x480, 25° FOV, 1,000 nits, XR2, 6/128 GB, 590 mAh.

detail: PR: Air 2 launched on Amazon US on 2023-11-08 and became #1 best-selling smart glasses the next day.

detail: X2 Lite demo at CES 2024: about 60 g, 12MP camera, Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1, full-colour microLED waveguide 30° FOV / 1,500 nits; 'expected to release in Q3 2024'.

detail: PR: 'RayNeo Lights Up IFA 2024 with Its Next-Gen AR Innovations'.

detail: [Verification: partially supported — Cited MIXED article is dated 12 Jan 2025; RayNeo's PR Newswire release of 6 Jan 2025 gives the same specs (X3 Pro <85 g, 2,500 nits, AR1 Gen 1, mid-2025; V3 39 g, IMX681 HDR+OIS, 3 mics, 'later in 2025').] CES 2025 lineup:

detail: PR: next-gen XR glasses Air 3s unveiled at MWC 2025.

detail: X3 Pro China launch with JBD X-cube full-colour microLED light engine, etched waveguide and JBD ARTCs image engine; dual cameras.

detail: PR: X3 Pro demonstrated at AWE 2025.

detail: PR: global audio licensing partnership with Bang & Olufsen.

detail: RayNeo PR cites Counterpoint data giving RayNeo 24% of global AR glasses shipments in Q3 2025, ranked first.

detail: X3 Pro global launch review: €1,400 (€1,200 intro) / US$1,100 promo; 640x480, 30° FOV, 3,500 nits avg / 6,000 peak; 12MP camera (focus type not stated; image quality 'acceptable'); waveguide co-developed with Applied Materials; JBD microdisplays; AR1 Gen 1.

title: RayNeo X3 Pro named TIME Best Invention 2025
detail: PR: X3 Pro listed among TIME Best Inventions 2025.

detail: PR: X3 Pro eSIM untethered 4G prototype concept announced ahead of CES 2026.

detail: Air 4 Pro: 0.6-inch micro-OLED 1,200 nits 120 Hz, 76 g, Pixelworks Vision 4000, B&O audio; US$299, on sale 2026-01-25 (China launch 2025).

title: RayNeo Air 4 Pro global availability; early-bird US$249 (MSRP US$299)
detail: Air 4 Pro available globally on Amazon and rayneo.com; early-bird US$249 (MSRP US$299), Batman Edition US$269 (US$319).

title: MWC 2026: Air 4 Pro Batman/Joker editions
detail: PR: Air 4 Pro Batman and Joker editions shown at MWC 2026.

detail: PR claiming RayNeo holds roughly one-third of the global AR glasses market.

detail: PR claiming #1 global AR smart glasses shipments in Q1 2026.

detail: RayNeo blog on X3 Pro camera tech: 12MP Sony IMX681 colour camera plus monochrome tracking camera; 1440p video; 245 mAh shared battery limits recording to ~25-30 min. Focus type not stated.

detail: PR: RayNeo iO display AI glasses (33 g, no camera) and GT / GT Max cinematic glasses (no camera) unveiled.

detail: RayNeo blog guide: iO, GT, GT Max retail from 2026-09-04; X3 Pro US$1,099 (from US$1,299); Air 4 Pro, Air 3s Pro, Air 3s, Air 2s in stock.

detail: iO US$469, GT US$299 (46° FOV, 68 g), GT Max US$399 (59° FOV, 78 g, tandem micro-OLED) on sale; RayNeo claims #1 global AR glasses shipments for H1 2026; Air 4 series best-seller on Prime Day 2026.
